text:
Priya Rao: Kicking off NeoHealth POC — quick sync on scope, success criteria, and open blockers. Can we confirm day0 agenda and who needs to be on the call? They want a 2-week trial window and a short eval cadence.
Samir Patel: +1. I'll own model setup and prompts. Need to know if NeoHealth requires VPC/private deployment or if hosted API is ok for the initial trial.
Priya Rao: Hosted preferred initially, but security team will confirm. Main success metrics: 1) accuracy vs their golden set (F1 >= 0.85), 2) p95 latency < 300ms, 3) cost target < $X per 1k tokens (they asked for an estimate).
Emily Chen: Thanks — can we get the golden set and ~50 representative prompts from them before day0? That will let us precompute eval baselines. Also we should pin a model version during the POC to avoid drift.
Ryan Gomez: For pricing: we can offer 2-week trial credits on Hosted API. If they need sustained load we can propose a short Reserved/Dedicated window (1 month minimal) with burst. I'll draft numbers.
Claire Hu: Security asks we should flag early: SSO/SAML, IP allowlist, data retention policy, and whether PHI will be sent to the API (they mentioned healthcare data). If PHI -> private deployment or strict contract terms + BAAs.
Samir Patel: Noted. If PHI is in scope we should not use shared GPU pools. Also: prompt caching may surface PHI in logs unless we turn off/anon. I'll add config options.
Priya Rao: Day0 agenda proposal (30–45m):
- 5m intro & goals
- 10m infra & security (Claire)
- 10m POC success metrics & eval plan (Emily)
- 10m demo of sample prompt flow + integration points (Samir)
- 5–10m next steps + timeline / contacts
Is that too heavy?
Emily Chen: Looks good. I'll bring a minimal eval harness and sample prompts. Quick ask: can NeoHealth share a simple CSV of examples (input, expected output)? Even 100 rows helps.
Priya Rao: I'll request that in the kickoff invite. Also adding stakeholder list: NeoHealth product lead (Alex), security lead (Marta), infra lead (Deepak), and an engineer (Olivia).
Ryan Gomez: I'll attach the trial credit agreement and an options sheet for reserved pricing. Quick question: do we want to surface quantized model options in the POC (smaller cost footprint) or keep full precision to avoid quality variance?
Samir Patel: Let's present both. Show latency/cost tradeoffs: e.g., guanaco-7b-q4 ~40% cheaper, p95 improves on smaller seqs. But baseline eval should be on the highest-quality variant to prove accuracy.
Claire Hu: Also need to send NeoHealth our security questionnaire and BAA template (if PHI). Can someone confirm who on legal to loop in? Priya / Ryan?
Priya Rao: I'll loop in legal after the kickoff once Marta confirms PHI. For now I'll attach a short checklist in the invite.
deploy-bot: Reminder — calendar invite created for 2418903600 (NeoHealth POC kick).
Samir Patel: Pre-kick tasks:
- Samir: prepare pinned model + sample integration snippet (will include a minimal SDK example)
- Emily: eval harness + baseline metrics (need CSV/golden set)
- Claire: list of security questions to ask on day0
- Ryan: pricing sheet and trial credit terms
Priya Rao: Timeline: Day0 kickoff (T+0), baseline eval ready by T+3, mid-POC check T+7, final readout T+13. Any objections?
Emily Chen: Fine. If we get the golden set late we may shift eval baseline to T+4.
Ryan Gomez: No objections. I'll prepare the pricing options and attach to the invite.
Priya Rao: Blockers we should flag now:
- NDA signed (legal)
- PHI confirmation (security)
- VPC/IP allowlist access if they need private endpoints
- Sample prompts/golden set provided by NeoHealth
If any of these aren't resolved by Day0, we'll document mitigations and next steps.
Samir Patel: One more tech note: please ask NeoHealth about max sequence length and expected concurrency. That drives kernel selection and batch sizing.
Priya Rao: Good call. I'll add that question to the pre-kick form.
Claire Hu: I'll prepare the short security slide (data flows, retention, encryption at rest/in transit, logging controls).
Priya Rao: Thanks everyone — I'll send the invite + pre-kick survey and attach Ryan's pricing. Meeting scheduled for T+0 at 0900 PT.
Emily Chen: :thumbsup: See you then.
Ryan Gomez: I'll be on the call.
Samir Patel: 👍
Priya Rao: Thread closing — will post updates here after the invite goes out and when legal confirms NDA.
